summary: Comprehensive testing completed for Privacy-First RAG application. All backend APIs (health, ingest, ask, notes, stats, delete) working correctly. Frontend fully functional with all three tabs (CHAT, NOTES, SYS) operational. Full RAG integration verified: note ingestion → vector indexing → query retrieval → answer generation with sources. Extractive fallback working as expected (Ollama unavailable in test environment).

minor.issue: ChromaDB cleanup uses try/except that silently fails (line 406). Best-effort cleanup could leave orphaned vectors if ChromaDB operation fails.
No pagination - returns all notes with hard limit of 1000. Could be slow with large datasets.

issues: No loading indicator shown during delete operation (minor UX issue)

react_native_issues.issue: Version mismatch warning: installed 55.0.9, expected ~14.0.8. Functionality works but should be updated for compatibility.
Deprecation warnings: 'style.resizeMode' and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated. Non-breaking but should migrate to new API.

action_items: Consider adding pagination to GET /api/notes for scalability
Add loading indicator for delete operation in NOTES tab
Migrate deprecated style.resizeMode and props.pointerEvents to new API
